lessons.title: Lesson 1: Rural lifestyle and farming vocabulary
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Rural lifestyle and farming vocabulary.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Used to compare how two people or things perform an action. For adverbs ending in -ly, add 'more' (more quietly); for irregular adverbs, change the form (fast -> faster, well -> better, badly -> worse, hard -> harder).
concepts.example: He drives more carefully than his brother. / Farmers work harder during harvest season.
concepts.essence: Adverbs modify verbs of action, whereas adjectives modify nouns.

rules.meaning: Fast -> faster; Early -> earlier; Late -> later; Well -> better; Badly -> worse; Far -> farther/further.
rules.example: She ran faster than anyone else in the school competition.
rules.essence: Do not add 'more' to adverbs that already have special irregular comparative endings.

workedExamples.prompt: Complete the sentence with the comparative form of the adverb in brackets: 'In the countryside, life moves (slowly) __________ than in big cities.'
steps: Step 1: 'Slowly' is a two-syllable adverb ending in -ly.
Step 2: Add 'more' before the adverb: 'more slowly'.
Step 3: Complete sentence: 'In the countryside, life moves more slowly than in big cities.'

commonMistakes.why: 'Fast' is both an adjective and an adverb; there is no word 'fastly'. The comparative form is 'faster'.
